title: Robot data pipeline: numerical supplement
scope: Retained August-September 2026 experiments; not a fresh rerun. Experiments below have different data subsets and validation coverage.

time_association_case.rule: latest declared source timestamp at or before control timestamp
time_association_case.limit: Three of six sampled control anchors shown, one real episode. Not proof of exposure-time or physical clock accuracy.

lossless_time_index_comparison.limit: One warm CPU metadata-lookup comparison; video decode and end-to-end training speed are not measured by this number.

video_conversion_calibration.encoding: H264, output playback clock 30 FPS, fixed GOP30, B=0, yuv420p
video_conversion_calibration.source_time_index: Retained separately; output playback timestamps do not establish sensor capture times.
video_conversion_calibration.limit: Whole conversion-pipeline byte ratios; not an isolated B-frame or equal-quality compression comparison. Image-error checks are not policy-quality tests.

published_common_view.limit: All payloads hashed; full decoding of all 634 episodes or every possible training window not claimed.

recipe_audit_20260828.limit: One recipe audit, not a universal rejection of the two source episodes.

cpu_sample_parity_20260908.limit: Bounded repeated plans, not all-episode coverage or measured GPU acceleration.

training_functional_checks.limit: Bounded functional tests; no policy-quality or production reliability claim.

anonymized_raw_audit.limit: Timestamp semantics and clock mapping unresolved; not a measured physical camera latency or synchronization error.
